newsitem.title: USA: NY's Bruno says 6-wk budget to include school aid.
newsitem.headline: NY's Bruno says 6-wk budget to include school aid.

text.p: New York State Senate Majority Leader Joseph Bruno, R-Troy, Monday said the new, six-week interim budget that Albany lawmakers were expected to approve by week's end would include $1.5 billion of school aid.

"This includes the school aid payment of over a billion and a half dollars, which is the last payment for this current year that we're in, so it kind of takes the pressure off with the cashflow to the various other things that are involved in waiting for the budget," he told reporters in Albany, after the first major meeting by lawmakers in two weeks.
